# Foundations of Project Planning

Author1, Author2, and Author3

<span style="color: red;">ALL CONTENT IN THIS REPORT IS PRELIMINARY AND DRAFT. DO NOT REFERENCE FOR ANY PURPOSE.</span>

Key topics:  

- Existing guidelines and standards (global, national, and regional). See [Appendix](https://skmckay.github.io/NBS.Manual.Of.Practice/existing-nbs-manuals.html).  
- Principles of engineering design of NBS. See King et al. (2021).  
- Building systems context: physical, ecological, social. Designing at local and systems scales (de Vries et al. 2021, Hall and van Rees 2026).  
- Design maturity.  
- Design objectives: primary vs. secondary outcomes, performance goals and risk tolerance.  
- Life cycle targets for design life and levels of services.
